summary: Iteration 121 — Archive Groups feature (BİTMİŞ/İPTAL/SİLİNMİŞ) frontend testing. Backend already verified 5/5 pytest + curl e2e per handoff. Live web UI login succeeded but the TasksPanel is not visible in the default HUD state I captured (SERTEX HUD + chat panels only), so I could not click archive-toggle end-to-end. However, exhaustive code review of TasksPanel.jsx + TaskContextMenu.jsx (web) and mobile/app/archive.tsx + task/[id].tsx + (tabs)/tasks.tsx confirms ALL required testIDs and permission gating are correctly wired on BOTH platforms.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise archive-toggle/chips live because the TasksPanel widget was not visible in the default HUD after login (right side shows Neural Link/chat; left column shows System/Neural Core). No overdue popup appeared to dismiss. Tasks panel may be collapsed/detached by default — main agent should confirm the panel is mounted by default or provide the trigger to open it. Code paths themselves are correct.

action_items: Main agent: verify the desktop HUD renders the TasksPanel by default (or provide a stable trigger/testid to open it) so archive-toggle can be reached from login without extra manual steps.

Once TasksPanel is visible on load, re-test can be done via a simple self-test: click archive-toggle → verify 3 chips with counts → click each chip → for admin+deleted verify archive-empty-trash appears when deleted>0 → right-click active task → verify ctx-cancel-task + ctx-delete present. Mobile parity: /archive route already exposes archive-screen + archive-group-* + archive-restore-button-<id> + archive-permanent-delete-button-<id> + archive-empty-trash-button correctly gated to isAdmin.
critical_code_review_comments: WEB — TasksPanel.jsx lines 1923-1950: chips array + archive-group-chips grid + archive-empty-trash button correctly gated on `archiveGroup === 'deleted' && isAdmin && archiveCounts.deleted > 0`. Chips render side-by-side (grid-cols-3). Counts wired to /tasks/archive-counts.

WEB — TaskContextMenu.jsx lines 80-93 (archive/trash mode) and 244-254 (active mode): ctx-cancel-task appears only when `archiveGroup === null && !task.archived` (active only); ctx-restore/ctx-uncancel + ctx-permanent-delete correctly appear only for the appropriate archive group; ctx-permanent-delete additionally gated by `archiveGroup === 'deleted' && isAdmin` — matches spec (emp1_test will NOT see it).

WEB — TasksPanel.jsx `removeTask` (line 913-929) delegates to `tasksApi.delete` which per handoff maps to soft-delete backend; success toast 'Silindi' shown — behavior matches 'Sil moves to trash, not permanent'.

MOBILE — archive.tsx: three chips are laid out side-by-side via `chipsRow` (flexDirection:'row', flex:1 per chip) with testIDs archive-group-done/-cancelled/-deleted (constants/testIds.ts:ARCHIVE.groupDone/Cancelled/Deleted). Counts shown per chip. Correct.

MOBILE — archive.tsx: `archive-empty-trash-button` correctly gated to `group === 'deleted' && isAdmin && counts.deleted > 0`. `archive-permanent-delete-button-<id>` per-row gated to `group === 'deleted' && isAdmin`. Non-admin (emp1_test) will not see either. Confirm modals wired to archive-permanent-confirm / archive-empty-confirm.
MOBILE — task/[id].tsx lines 304-320: task-detail-cancel-button (calls api.cancelTask) + task-detail-delete (which per api client is soft-delete) both present. Correct.
MOBILE — (tabs)/tasks.tsx line 280: tasks-open-archive-button in header pushes /archive — matches spec.

PARITE — Both platforms use identical group keys (done/cancelled/deleted) and views (archived/cancelled/trash) and identical archive-counts endpoint. Deleted+cancelled tasks are fetched via the archive-specific view param and are absent from the active list (backend list already filters).
Low-severity observation carried over from iter120: mobile still has deprecated shadow* prop warnings on RN Web (unrelated to this feature).
TasksPanel.jsx is >2000 lines — approaching splitting threshold. Not blocking but worth flagging for future refactor.
